motivated a lot of my work

class about transformers

natural intelligence work,

surprising to you.

corpus, we optimize the
network's parameters in order
to get them to encode some
knowledge or some skills

one of the things

about language models

to learn from
information in context.

examples of a task
or some facts or some documents

context, and the models

doing cognitive science

do all kinds of
controlled experiments

do on natural intelligences,

novel information.

I'm going to tell you

done where we found some pretty
striking differences in
how these models generalize

stored in their parameters

studying several paths to bridge

how these findings might

interested, the things
